title: Cloud-machine sign-in advice prints a Python command that fails under a pipx install
description: cli-login stores/agent.py agent_command() builds its advice from os.path.basename(sys.executable), and docs/cli-login.md says python -m cli_login.stores.agent serve. Under the documented pipx install, cli_login exists only in the tool's private virtualenv, so a bare python or python3.12 on PATH should not find the module. This is the path an agent on a cloud computer with no keyring takes before papyrus login --remote. Found by reading the code on 2026-11-04; not yet reproduced on a real cloud machine. Fix: print the full sys.executable in cli-login, or give the papyrus command its own subcommand to start the memory agent, then correct the docs and test from a clean pipx install on Linux with no keyring.
